responsibility: Provides compiler-side, language-independent diagnostic support for tree-based GCC front ends and the GIMPLE middle end. It reports current function/module context, unwinds macro-expansion traces into note diagnostics, implements the default tree pretty-printer hooks for %E/%D/%F/%T formatting, computes inlining-location stacks for diagnostics, and installs the default starter/finalizer/path/client-data hooks via tree_diagnostics_defaults.
same_name_distinction: Implements the tree-specific diagnostic behavior declared in tree-diagnostic.h, including macro-expansion unwinding, default %E/%D/%F/%T formatting, inlining-location handling, and installation of default diagnostic hooks.
